description: This file defines an internal asynchronous mutual exclusion mechanism, named AsyncLock, which provides async-compatible lock semantics similar to a mutex, including an inner LockReleaser class to facilitate the use of 'using' statements for automatic release of the lock.

classes.name: AsyncLock
classes.description: An async mutex-like class supporting lock acquisition via LockAsync method, maintaining lock state with a SemaphoreSlim, and providing a LockReleaser for scope-based release.

classes.name: AsyncLock.LockReleaser
classes.description: A disposable helper class that releases the AsyncLock when disposed, enabling use with 'using' statements.

methods.name: AsyncLock()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the internal SemaphoreSlim to 1.

methods.name: LockAsync()
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, returning a ValueTask containing an IDisposable (LockReleaser) to release the lock.

methods.name: LockReleaser.Dispose()
methods.description: Releases the semaphore and releases internal reference, ensuring lock is freed upon disposal.
